title: Tube strikes: TfL's own pages
why: tfl.gov.uk answered every request (status-updates/industrial-action, campaigns/strikes, robots.txt) with HTTP 403 and a 'Verification required, enable JavaScript and cookies' challenge page. That is a refusal of automated readers, so I stopped and did not work round it. No strike date, line or service level is recorded here because none was read.
